content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Explain how exercise affects respiration rate
Describe changes in breathing and heart rate during exercise
Explain the switch from aerobic to anaerobic respiration during intense exercise
Understand how the body adapts to regular exercise

During exercise, muscles need more energy, so respiration rate increases. The body makes several adjustments to deliver more oxygen and glucose to muscles and remove more carbon dioxide. Understanding these changes helps explain how exercise affects the body.
Why Does Exercise Increase Energy Demand?
More ATP needed = more respiration required
More O₂ in, more CO₂ out
